references.title: Google Street View, Bulevardi 11, April2023 leafless adjacent facade view
Helsinki City Museum, exact building identity and asymmetric Jugend facade description

observations: Actual leafless Street View shows reddish brown textured lower plaster, warmer ochre upper plaster, gray pale window frames and dark shop plinth.
Four rectangular upper window rows plus a smaller upper arched row, varied grouped lights and projecting balconies; actual corner tower and bays come from unchanged native geometry.
City Museum binds the exact VTJ and documents an asymmetric Jugend facade with several opening forms; the original drawing retains varied axes rather than a generic symmetric classical elevation.
limitations: Only exact outward southeast street-front facets and their connected forward-facing bay/turret facets are selected; roof and side/courtyard walls retain native materials.

Window dimensions, spacing and balcony drawing are reference-led approximations, not a measured elevation survey. Street View photos are appearance references only; no pixels, people, trees or commercial branding are copied.
Both current official appearance themes lack images for this exact source building; no2017model or theme is used.
